title: Equivalence of subsets containing and avoiding a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The finite subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ containing $i$ are in bijection with those avoiding $i$, by deleting $i$ in one direction and adjoining it in the other.
